topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Of course, I understand about the fence. It’s a lovely idea, really, to mark the spaces where we grow together, yet apart. I’ve been thinking about how the line between our gardens has always been a bit blurry, like the edges of a watercolor. Adding a fence could be a beautiful way to celebrate the boundaries that, in their clarity, actually bring us closer. I’d be happy to help you choose the wood, and we could plant some climbing vines too, so it feels less like a barrier and more like an invitation to the wildgreen world. What do you say we start this weekend, maybe with a picnic afterwards to celebrate the beginning?
